blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Domestic fuel prices are likely to increase by as much as P10.50 per liter due to the sustained escalation of tensions in the Middle East. Citing price developments in the Asian market and the movement of foreign exchange as of Thursday, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas, in a message to journalists on Friday, said diesel prices are forecast to rise between P10 and P10.50 per liter and gasoline between P4.50 and P5 per liter.
